rules.statement: The right to a retransfer of immovable property under a deed is movable property, and the seizure and sale were correctly made according to the Roman-Dutch law.
rules.supporting_quote: "On this point there is the authority of van der Keessel Select Theses, Book 2, chap. 1, sec. 14, para. 178-179 . The -translation of this is to be found in Lorensz's van der Keessel at. p. 59."
